finding: The stated three Stage2 diagnostics are present. In addition, the current BODY01 controller transition diagnostic is a fourth changed-source diagnostic. It must not be hidden by aggregate lint counts or attributed to BODY07.
baseline_reuse: BODY07 chain join: exact baseline reuse and exact reviewed-candidate transfer are separately counted below. Diagnostics absent from both exact identity sets remain changed/unmatched. This is identity evidence, not authorship attribution.

harness_classification.private_cfg_test: Noncritical only while code is cfg(all(test, feature)) or cfg(test), has no public/re-exported cross-crate entry, and changes no dependency, lockfile, runtime path, schema, selector, or default build.
harness_classification.cross_crate_public_feature: Critical: a default-off feature that exposes a cross-crate entry creates externally selectable public build surface and violates the retained no-public/runtime condition.
harness_classification.private_capture_route: Advisory only: compatible with SC-LANDSURFACEENERGY-001 numerical-methods.md:586-590 only if an immutable clone of the actual prepared M1CoupledColumnInput is taken at the real prefix-to-solver boundary before either policy is chosen or invoked. A bit-encoded private envelope may transport that clone to a same-crate private LSE harness; it must not reconstruct input from JSON traces, iteration-15 state, or guessed replay. CoveredColumnInputs being serde and the stated remaining M1 input fields being public are insufficient by themselves: every required M1CoupledColumnInput field and floating-point bit must be verified for correspondence before either policy. With that proof, private cfg(test) guards and no public/re-exported interface, dependency/lockfile, production path, schema, or selector change, it remains noncritical. This is not implementation approval.

prospective_cpu_clock_assessment: Advisory only: Linux /proc/self/stat utime+stime ticks converted with a getconf CLK_TCK value can satisfy the required process-CPU clock if CPU samples bracket the same solver-entry-to-return interval as the monotonic wall measurement. Querying tick resolution before the timed interval keeps resolution lookup outside it. Record method, tick resolution, start/end ticks, conversion and clock boundaries; reject/record malformed stat fields, absent/nonpositive CLK_TCK, conversion overflow, unsupported platform, or nonmonotonic/invalid samples without a default. No unsafe block or new dependency is inherently required. This does not itself qualify a release measurement.
required_followup: After fixes, rerun the exact focused Clippy argv above; strict Clippy remains a required gate and is not certified while its inherited dependency failure persists. If the implementation crosses into Critical scope, the package's exact 900-second Critical command is cargo nextest run --workspace --profile full; that command is a full-workspace correctness gate, not a substitute for lint, fmt, deny, or affected tests.
original_body01_qa_verdict: No blocking findings. Non-blocking: full/A1/release qualification remains outside BODY01. QA PASS: BODY01 is test-only, private, source-custodied, and passes its 16 focused controls plus formatting.
